newsitem.title: GERMANY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUPER-G WINNER MAIER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUPER-G WINNER MAIER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a men's super-G race in the Alpine skiiing World Cup on Sunday:

Maier had to give up skiing at age of 15 because of problem with a bone in a knee. He earned his living as a bricklayer and ski instructor before deciding to return to the sport. Until this season he had never finished in the top 10 of a World Cup race. Despite late start number of 32 the stocky racer finished second in Friday's super-G in Garmisch before going one place better on Sunday with start bib 18, his first World Cup triumph.
